title: Announcement choreography and release-notes runway for public feature launch
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate cross-functional delivery of the public announcement for the new Dedicated autoscaling and cost-tuning features. Produce final blog post, release notes package, email campaign, social thread calendar, and a customer-facing webinar. Ensure all assets are reviewed, signed off, and scheduled with owners and fallbacks. Focus on sequencing to avoid confusion for existing Dedicated customers and to maximize developer signups for Hosted API.
goals: Publish a feature blog and release notes synchronized across channels within a 24-hour window
Drive 20% increase in developer sign-ups from blog and webinar CTA over baseline launch period
Prevent customer-facing regressions by coordinating a pre-launch QA and rollback plan
timeline: D-14: Draft blog outline in Confluence (owner: PM) and tech PRD linked; invite Eng/Design to draft technical callouts
D-10: First pass release notes draft (owner: Docs) with API samples and migration notes
D-8: Marketing assets brief (owner: Growth) — social hooks, hero image requests to Design
D-6: Legal and compliance review window opens (owner: Legal); ensure no regulated claims
D-5: Internal demo + dry run for webinar (owner: Solutions) — record for evergreen use
D-3: Final copy freeze for blog & email (owner: PM); schedule publish times and syndication
D-2: QA checklist run on release notes and in-product banner (owner: Eng/Reliability); confirm safe rollback plan
D-Day: Publish blog at 09:00 PDT, send early-access email to enterprise customers at 09:15 PDT, public email at 11:00 PDT, social thread at 11:05 PDT, webinar live at 13:00 PDT
D+1: Dashboard metrics review and ops standup to triage churn/bugs
D+7: Post-launch quantitative readout (engagement, signups, errors) and qualitative feedback aggregation
owners_and_contacts: On-call SRE for launch window: Nora Ibrahim (pager: +1-555-0102)
checklist: Finalize technical release notes with code samples and migration steps
Confirm blog hero image and alt text (accessibility review)
Prepare enterprise-specific email template and opt-out lists
Social copy 3 variants approved (short, medium, long) and linked assets
Webinar slide deck + runbook and Q&A doc prepared
In-product banner copy + link destinations verified
QA smoke tests for API compatibility and Dedicated autoscaling behavior
Rollback plan documented with compatible model variants and traffic routing policy
Support playbook and canned responses for common customer questions
Telemetry dashboards and SLO alerts configured for launch window
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Last-minute regression in runtime impacting Dedicated throughput — Mitigation: schedule hotfix runway and empower emergency rollback to previous model variant; postpone public email if not resolved
Risk: Confusing messaging for customers on pricing/committed capacity — Mitigation: add an explicit FAQ block in release notes and enterprise email; include billing SME on review
Risk: Webinar capacity or platform failure — Mitigation: have pre-recorded fallback and host on two CDN regions; Solutions to host on Zoom + YouTube stream
Risk: Social amplification picks up an issue — Mitigation: prepare holding statement and prioritised triage channel (Slack #launch-incident)
updates: 2026-03-01: Initial ticket created; scope covers blog, release notes, email, social, webinar. PM kick-off done with Eng/Design/Growth.
2026-03-04: Docs created first draft of release notes; ENG requested to add explicit migration code sample for reserved capacity customers (PR opened: #238).
2026-03-06: Design delivered hero image concepts; updated accessibility alt text and high-contrast variant requested by Design lead.
2026-03-08: Legal reviewed claim language for SLA and requested removal of 'instant' phrasing. Marketing adjusted headline to 'predictable autoscaling'.
2026-03-09: Webinar vendor confirmed streaming fallback; Ola scheduled dry run for D-5. Recording plan finalized.

2026-03-11: QA found 2 minor API examples that could mislead customers about pinning model versions; Docs and Eng fixed samples and added a note in release notes. Copy freeze scheduled for 2026-03-13.
2026-03-12: Growth queued social variants; pre-approval flow started in Slack #comm-approval. Confirmed SRE on-call for D-Day (Nora).
acceptance_criteria: All launch assets (blog, release notes, email templates, social posts, webinar page, in-product banner) approved by PM, Design, Legal, and Engineering
Release notes published in the docs repo and linked from blog and in-product banner
Webinar scheduled with registration page and reminder cadence set
Telemetry and SLO alerts deployed for launch window and smoke tests pass
Support playbook uploaded to internal helpdesk and at least two support reps briefed
post_launch_plan: D+1: 30-minute ops debrief; collect incidents and open follow-ups
D+3: Product-led email to trial users with deep-dive usage tips
D+7: Compile engagement metrics (blog views, email CTR, webinar attendees, sign-ups) and share with execs
D+14: Post-launch retrospective and decision log for retention of any temporary mitigations
